column1: # claude layer — what install.sh writes for this layer.
# One line per entry, TAB-separated:  mode<TAB>src<TAB>dest
#   mode  copy | tree | block | json | post
#   src   path relative to this directory
#   dest  path relative to $HOME (no leading / or ~, no ..); "-" for post
# Kit-owned files live under ~/.claude/palmface/ (replaced on re-install, removed on uninstall).
# The user's own ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md only gets a marked block that imports Palmface's.
# Nothing here writes ~/.claude/palmface-local/ (the user's files) or Claude Code's memory.
# Working agreements, imported from the user's CLAUDE.md; the long guides, read on demand
# Behaviour hooks (session 4) and their shared helpers
# Hook registrations, merged into the user's settings.json (their values win, arrays union)
